notes: No model in the repository reads from this source; variables are the full lexicon VOCAB. (earth2studio/lexicon/ghcn.py GHCNDailyLexicon.VOCAB, 12 keys).
Stations are 11-character GHCN IDs (Atlanta Hartsfield, Atlanta Fulton Co, San Francisco, Chicago O'Hare); time and 1 day tolerance follow the class docstring example (ghcn.py:405-406).
Not every station reports every element, so fewer variables may be returned than requested.
